name: Els Pallaresos (Spain)
description: Green field with three yellow straws arranged in bend, and a black cross of Saint Thecla at the lower fly.
history: The official flag of Els Pallaresos is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with three yellow straws arranged in bend and the black cross of Saint Thecla at the lower fly corner; published in the DOGC on 10 July 1991.

features.role: three straws arranged diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly
